scope: Shared presentation code in full and focused HTML; original business script preserved. No new endpoint, permission or persistent private data.

fixes.finding: Wide nonmodal reader becoming modal left focus in the newly inert background.
fixes.change: Focus reader close only when entering single-reader mode with focus outside.

fixes.finding: Replacing or emptying material rows could close a focused reader with no return target.
fixes.change: Return only reader-owned focus to visible source, material filter or empty-list status; keep background editor focus. Clear stale text.

fixes.finding: Queued invalid focus could run after identity/reset cleared errors.
fixes.change: Require original error map to remain current and choose a visible eligible field.

fixes.finding: Confirmation explanation had no accessible-description relationship.
fixes.change: Associate dialog with its actual explanation using aria-describedby.

fixes.finding: Closing an already closed confirmation reused its old focus target during identity input.
fixes.change: Clear return target and continuation immediately; restore focus only for an actually open dialog and eligible target.

fixes.finding: Coarse-pointer 44px minimum lost CSS specificity to primary 36px and typed fields.
fixes.change: Priority rule only for coarse pointers; exclude checkbox/radio inputs, retain padded labels.

fixes.finding: A removed/hidden confirmation target left private copied details and an old continuation in an open dialog.
fixes.change: Cancel on target invalidation, clear copied title/description and continuation. Original resourceError403 is covered.
